name: Surbhi Islam

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Surbhi Islam writes in Hindi, English and Bengali. Her books include the Hindi poetry collection The Bliss of Solitude, published by Notion Press in 2019, and Silent Uproar, published by Author’s Ink Publications in 2023. The earlier collection presents Hindi poetry in Roman script, making language and reading habits part of its approach to readers.

In “A window left open”, her poem in Kabita Live, the closing of a door never quite ends a relationship. The recurring open window holds both hope and the fear of repeating a painful cycle. Its return in the final stanza leaves the speaker suspended between self-protection and the wish to begin again.
